purpose.summary: Reproduce the exact ERGON-CHANGE-0014 bounded-mining target while retaining the exact ERGON-CHANGE-0010 report as an independently validated behavioral reference.
scope: Fresh-clone and build the exact signed ERGON-CHANGE-0014 commit 8a7f630333a8481b095c0fa82b25f18e929b0171 and validate its accepted record, direct parent, four technical paths, signatures and clean source identity.

Validate the existing ERGON-CHANGE-0010 Observed report only against its own immutable candidate, parent, record and three-path inventory, then validate the reproduced report only against the new ERGON-CHANGE-0014 target.
Require the two semantic projections to differ only at the closed candidate, integration-parent, record, technical-inventory and corresponding signature identity pointers.
Require every target-invariant scenario, lifecycle, functional selection, launch mode, privacy flag, consensus claim and build-source binding to remain equal.
Keep the locked Ubuntu 22.04 ARM64 environment, fresh builds, closed failure attribution, cleanup, raw-output exclusion and external-review promotion authority unchanged.
exclusions: No workflow, container, dependency, production-node build, node, consensus, validation, P2P, storage, RPC, wallet, Chronik, activation, testnet, mainnet, or operator-binary change.

No modification of the accepted ERGON-CHANGE-0014 technical target, matrix bytes, scenarios, functional scripts, inherited selection, existing ERGON-CHANGE-0010 report or its pinned semantic projection.
No child stdout, stderr, traceback, line number, command, path, port, environment, secret, return code or free-form error text is retained or printed.
No target-identity difference may be treated as a behavioral difference, and no behavioral difference may be hidden as a target-identity difference.
No retry, incoming evidence, proof promotion, deterministic-build claim, public-network claim or mainnet-coexistence claim.

files.production_reachability: None; public evidence orchestration and validation only.
files.test_reachability: Builds and runs the exact accepted ERGON-CHANGE-0014 matrix, validates both target lineages independently, and permits only the closed target-identity projection differences.

commands: Fresh-clone and build Bitcoin Static v24.0.5 commit 2e8d5f7635c899cc99e71f06dedbe72b3ff7f07b in the exact locked Ubuntu 22.04 ARM64 environment.
expected_results: The baseline source is clean at the exact public commit and tree, its build root was absent before configuration, and its binary and config identities are recorded in the build receipt.

commands: Fresh-clone and build the exact accepted ERGON-CHANGE-0014 technical candidate 8a7f630333a8481b095c0fa82b25f18e929b0171 in a distinct root under the same locked environment.
expected_results: The candidate source is clean at the exact signed public commit and tree, its build root was absent before configuration, and its binary and config identities are recorded independently.

scenarios.command: Run the unchanged accepted mixed-node coexistence, restart, full-reindex, chainstate-reindex, bounded protected-reorganization, physical-pruning, and cross-mining scenario from the exact technical candidate.
expected_results: Every accepted lifecycle and compatibility oracle passes, both source identities remain unchanged, the work root is removed, and the behavioral projection matches the existing public Observed report with exactly the governed target-identity differences.
failure_conditions: Any clone, signature, lineage, record, source, build, lifecycle, scenario, cleanup, privacy, report, or semantic-projection divergence fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the unchanged accepted zero-subsidy mining fixture with the freshly built exact baseline daemon and its own cache and datadir.
expected_results: The inherited mining fixture passes without skip or source mutation under the exact baseline role.
failure_conditions: Any cache reuse or escape, skip, timeout, nonzero exit, source mutation, identity mismatch, or cleanup failure fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the unchanged accepted zero-subsidy mining fixture with the freshly built exact candidate daemon and a distinct cache and datadir.
expected_results: The inherited mining fixture passes without skip or source mutation under the exact candidate role.
failure_conditions: Any cache alias, reuse or escape, skip, timeout, nonzero exit, source mutation, identity mismatch, or cleanup failure fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the unchanged accepted feature_abortnode.py selection through its default node-launch path with a fresh candidate build and scenario-local cache.
expected_results: The inherited default-launch scenario passes with byte-identical selection and no source-tree writes.
failure_conditions: Any inherited-selection drift, cache escape, skip, timeout, nonzero exit, source mutation, or cleanup failure fails closed.

platforms: GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 22.04 ARM64 virtual machine with its mutable image identity recorded but excluded from deterministic-build claims
Digest-pinned Ubuntu 22.04 linux/arm64 container with packages resolved from the signed 20260901T000000Z Ubuntu archive snapshot

limitations: Publishing this binding does not reproduce ERGON-CHANGE-0014 and does not promote evidence; only a later successful fresh execution can emit a proposed Reproduced comparison for external review.
A successful hosted comparison would establish behavioral equality only for the existing bounded four-scenario synthetic regtest matrix while preserving explicit target-lineage differences.

A successful future hosted comparison can cover only the existing bounded synthetic regtest matrix; it cannot establish deterministic builds, operator-binary equivalence, historical-chain replay, public-network peering, sustained operation or mainnet coexistence.
The ERGON-CHANGE-0014 record remains Open Question / record-review-only until successful evidence is separately reviewed and promoted.
counterevidence: Public workflow_dispatch runs 33901994571 and 33910672119 failed mixed-node-coexistence after both fresh builds and emitted no artifact.

Public workflow_dispatch run 33920764559 on exact diagnostic commit 0e9da9e91bda4777fd6b980d8e1f67132ced170a failed child-nonzero after default-protected-reorg with mine_and_compare as the last allowlisted feature frame and emitted no artifact.
The ERGON-CHANGE-0014 bounded-mining target passed one full maintainer-local macOS ARM64 feature execution, but no fresh hosted execution of that exact target exists yet.
Separating reference and candidate target contracts cannot turn a failed run into evidence and cannot promote the existing ERGON-CHANGE-0010 Observed report.
